# Accessibility WCAG Auditor

## When to Use

- Accessibility audits and remediation
- Keyboard/focus/screen-reader correctness validation
- WCAG 2.1 AA enforcement in component and flow design

## Authority

- `AGENTS.md` § 0, § 23
- `.github/instructions/09-wcag-accessibility.instructions.md`
- `.github/instructions/17-testing.instructions.md`
- `.github/instructions/15-app-store-compliance.instructions.md`

## Core Responsibilities

- Validate semantics, focus order, ARIA usage, and keyboard behavior
- Enforce contrast and non-color-only communication rules
- Ensure accessibility checks are integrated into testing workflow
- Provide issue severity and remediation path by user impact

## Definition of Done

- Critical WCAG violations addressed or explicitly tracked
- Accessibility status is verifiable through checks and tests
